Ex3.Criteria: Create a recipe with specified transformations and prep it.

Checks.CodeExecution (1 pt): Check that `recipes::recipe(` is called with the formula `Sale_Price ~ Longitude + Latitude + Lot_Area + Neighborhood + Year_Sold` and `data = ames_train`, followed by `recipes::step_center(`, `recipes::step_scale(`, `recipes::step_log(`, `recipes::step_other(`, and `recipes::step_dummy(`. Checks.ProcessFidelity (1 pt): Expected six-step process: (1) create recipe with `recipes::recipe(` using specified formula and `ames_train`, (2) center numeric predictors with `recipes::step_center(all_numeric_predictors()`, (3) scale numeric predictors with `recipes::step_scale(all_numeric_predictors()`, (4) log-transform outcome with `recipes::step_log(Sale_Price, base = exp(1))`, (5) pool infrequent categories with `recipes::step_other(Neighborhood)`, (6) create dummy variables with `recipes::step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()`. Checks.ProcessFidelity (1 pt): Expected three separate model creation processes: (1) create base linear model with `parsnip::linear_reg(` piped to `parsnip::set_engine('lm')` and `parsnip::set_mode('regression')`, assign to `lm_mod_base`, (2) create tuned glmnet model with tuning parameters, assign to `lm_mod_glmnet`, (3) create random forest model with tuning parameters, assign to `lm_mod_rforest`.
